title: Association of local oral infections with neuropathology: A cross-sectional study
summary: The aim of this study is to assess the potential correlation between the neuroinflammation and the oral health status of the patients. The patients who in the last 3 years received an MRT imaging of the brain will be invited for the evaluation of oral health status.

interventions.name: Patients who have undergone brain MRI in the last 3 years are invited for an intraoral examination. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient age > 18 years
2. Fully edentulous patients
3. Partially edentulous patients with or without dental implants
4. Completely edentulous patients with or without dental implants
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnant and breastfeeding women
2. Treatment with systemic antibiotics within the last 3 months
